summary: External LDAP group DN formatting prevents SCIM/role-binding sync in Private deployment
description:
Issue summary:
Customer NovaHealth reports that new hires are not getting expected role bindings in Redwood Private despite SCIM sync showing group membership. The customer uses an external LDAP-backed IdP that returns group DNs (e.g. "cn=research,ou=groups,dc=novah,dc=local") instead of short group names.

Impact:
- Multiple users in production cannot access dedicated-model endpoints; results in 403 for admin/console routes and 401 for token-exchange flows that require role assertion.
- Affects a single NovaHealth tenant in prod-us-east; ~18 users impacted (request from customer).

Environment:
- Deployment: Redwood Private (customer-managed VPC)
- IdP: On-prem LDAP-backed SAML/OIDC proxy (via identity-proxy)
- SCIM sync: outbound from IdP to Redwood SCIM connector running in customer VPC

Steps to reproduce (customer-provided):
1) Create a user in LDAP and add to group with DN form: cn=analytics,ou=groups,dc=novah,dc=local
2) SCIM sync runs (1m cadence); SCIM payload shows group attribute with full DN in the 'groups' array
3) User attempts to access model endpoint pinned to role 'analytics' -> receives 403
4) Manually editing the user's SCIM groups in Console to use short name 'analytics' immediately grants access

Observed behavior:
- Role bindings are created using an exact string match between SCIM group value and Redwood role names. When IdP supplies a DN, no match occurs, leaving users without roles.

Expected behavior:
- Either Redwood should support configurable group-name normalization for SCIM/SAML (strip DN prefixes/suffixes), or the IdP adapter should be documented as requiring short group names.

Recent changes / notes from customer:
- Customer rotated their LDAP connector two days before the issue started. The connector upgrade changed a setting to expose full DNs in the assertion/payload by default.
steps_to_reproduce: Create LDAP user and add to group with full DN
Wait for SCIM sync to run
Attempt to access an endpoint requiring role-bound access
Verify 403 despite SCIM showing group membership
comments: 2026-03-09 09:01 - Maya Chen (Support): Initial report received from NovaHealth CSM with SCIM payload and example 403 responses.
2026-03-09 10:20 - Priya Nair (SRE): Confirmed SCIM payload contains full DNs. Hypothesis: role name matching is exact-string; no normalization is configured for this tenant.

2026-03-09 13:45 - Evan Brooks (Platform Eng): Reproduced locally by injecting DN-form groups. Current behavior: SCIM connector stores group value as-is and role-mapper lookup uses direct equals comparison.
2026-03-10 08:05 - Support (Maya): Customer applied manual workaround by editing console group values to short names; access restored for 12/18 users. Remaining users pending manual edit.

2026-03-10 11:30 - Priya Nair (SRE): Scoped workaround: we applied a temporary SCIM transformation rule at the identity-proxy for the tenant to strip "cn=... ,ou=..." prefixes for the group attribute on inbound payloads. This will be rolled back after a permanent fix.
2026-03-11 09:10 - Customer (Nathan Lee, NovaHealth): Confirmed temporary rule fixed role binding for new syncs; asked for persistent fix and guidance for other tenants.
investigation_notes: Checked SCIM ingestion service logs and confirmed group values stored verbatim.
Ran local integration test with DN-style groups; role-mapper fails exact-match against role catalog which uses short names.

Searched codebase: role-mapper service does not currently have a tenant-level normalization configuration; global normalization exists but is disabled for Private tenants due to earlier compatibility issues.
Identity-proxy upgrade at customer changed LDAP adapter setting 'groupFormat' from 'shortName' to 'fullDN'; this correlates with incident start time.

Hypothesis: permanent fix options are (A) add tenant-level groupNormalization rules in SCIM ingestion to strip DN parts, (B) document and validate IdP connector settings to ensure short names are sent, or (C) extend role-mapper to support DN matching with pattern rules.
resolution_notes: Workaround applied: temporary transformation rule on identity-proxy to rewrite group values to short name; verified for new SCIM syncs.
Planned permanent fix: Platform Eng to add tenant-scoped SCIM group-normalization config (PR created) and add validation check during onboarding to detect DN-style group values. Target: v0.11.2.
Rollout notes: change gated behind feature flag for Private deployments; will coordinate with Customer Success for a maintenance window in NovaHealth VPC.
Follow-up: Update Private onboarding docs with IdP adapter recommended settings and add a check in the support runbook to look for 'cn=' prefixes when customers report missing roles.
Owner for fix: Evan Brooks (Platform Eng). Timeline: PR by 2026-03-15; canary in staging 2026-03-18; customer migration window week of 2026-03-22.
notes_for_engineering: Add tenant-level group normalization config to SCIM ingestion path. Provide a simple regex/strip option and ensure it is safe for Private customers. Add an onboarding validation that flags DN-style group values and surface a recommended config to the onboarding checklist.
public_facing_summary: Users in a NovaHealth Private deployment were denied access because their IdP began sending group values as full LDAP DNs. Temporary transformation rule restored access; a tenant-scoped normalization feature is planned.
